name: pki-toolkit
description: Browser-only PKI toolkit for X.509 chain validation, private-key matching, CSR inspection, certificate containers and revocation evidence.

scripts.check:syntax: find public/assets/js scripts tests -type f -name '*.js' -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 node --check && find scripts -type f -name '*.mjs' -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 node --check
scripts.check: npm run check:syntax && npm test && npm run test:differential && npm run test:fuzz
